Algorithm 27.9 (Shortest vector algorithm)
1. While basis  \( b_{1},\ldots,b_{n} \)  is not Gauss reduced, do:
(a) For each  \( i,1\leq i\leq n-1 \) , ensure that  \( |\mu_{i+1,i}|\leq1/2 \) .
If  \( |\mu_{i+1,i}|>1/2 \)  then  \( b_{i+1}\leftarrow b_{i+1}-mb_{i} \) , where m is the integer closest to  \( \mu_{i+1,i} \) .
(b) Pick any i such that  \( \|b_{i}\|>\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\|b_{i+1}\| \) , and interchange  \( b_{i} \)  and  \( b_{i+1} \) .
2. Output  \( b_{1} \) .
